title: fix(app-shell): the last two hand-rolled preview empties take EmptyDescription
body:
Fixes #8570

Executes the ruling on the card (comment 5602777270), including its ruling ② premise, which was put up to be overturned by measurement. **It held**, so both sites migrate and ruling ③ (a recorded retention) does not arise.

## The card's premise was wrong, and the ruling says why

The card describes both markers as "a word standing in for an **absent scalar**". Their predicates and their non-empty arms say otherwise:

| site | predicate | non-empty arm |
|---|---|---|
| `ValidationPreview` (cross-field, "Fields involved") | `fields.length === 0` | a chip row |
| `DatasourcePreview` (side rail, "Pool" / "SSL") | `Object.keys(value).length > 0` | a definition list (`dl`) |

Both are empty-**COLLECTION** statements. The only thing inline about them was their *layout*. So no phrase axis is added to `EmptyValue`, and its docblock and glyph are untouched (objectui#8506: *"the word was wrong, never the code — do not 'fix' the glyph"*).

The decisive reading is in one file: `DatasourcePreview` already carries `EmptyDescription` at line 160 for the same shape, 66 lines above the hand-rolled one. PR #8569's scope simply cut between them.

## Ruling ② — the premise, measured

**Premise: swapping in the block-level carrier does not change the rendered layout of the flex chip row.**

Measured in real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) against **real Tailwind v4 output** compiled for the exact class set in play, comparing `getBoundingClientRect` plus computed `display` / `font-size` / `line-height` / `font-style` for container and marker:

```
SUBJECT   flex flex-wrap gap-1, span vs div : IDENTICAL  -> premise HOLDS
          marker both ways: w 29.938  h 16  display block  12px/16px  italic

LIT CONTROL  non-flex block container, span vs div : DIFFERENT -> instrument is live
          span: w 29.938  h 14  display inline
          div : w 580     h 16  display block
```

A flex container **blockifies** its children, so the `span` being replaced already computed to `display: block`. The control is the same swap in a non-flex container, where it *does* move the boxes — without it, "no difference" and "the measurement never ran" are the same output.

⇒ Premise holds ⇒ migrate. No `className` is used to fight the shared component; the size passed is the one the site already rendered at.

## Ruling ① — and the one thing the migration had to decide

`DatasourcePreview`'s rail body renders at `text-[11px]`, and the current marker carries **no** size class — it inherits. `EmptyDescription`'s base ships `text-sm/relaxed`. Measured, same harness:

```
current  span (inherits 11px)     containerH 28.5   11px/16.5px  italic
ED, no className override         containerH 34.75  14px/22.75px normal   DRIFT
ED className="text-[11px] italic" containerH 28.5   11px/16.5px  italic   MATCH
ED className="text-xs italic"     containerH 28     12px/16px    italic   DRIFT
```

So this site takes `text-[11px] italic`, **not** the `text-xs` of the site 66 lines above it — that site sits in a `Section`, not in an 11px rail. `cn()` is `twMerge(clsx(…))`, so the passed size collapses `text-sm/relaxed` away; omitting it would have grown the word 11px → 14px and dropped the italic. `text-[11px] italic` is an existing in-repo spelling (`TranslationPreview.tsx:154`), not a third convention.

The marker's box does become block-level (full width rather than shrink-to-fit) — the intended consequence of the ruling, and it matches the `dl` it alternates with.

## The pin — what renders, with a lit control

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/emptyCollection-8570.test.tsx`, following the discipline of its `emptyCollection-8526.test.tsx` sibling.

**No string literal is pinned.** A pin on "not configured" reddens the next time someone rewords it and protects nothing structural. What is asserted is what reaches the DOM: the shared carrier's `data-slot="empty-description"`, no `data-slot="empty-value"`, and — the load-bearing half — a **lit populated control** at every site, fed a non-empty input, which must render the collection and **no** empty-description at all. Navigation is always by a title the *container* renders, never by anything the empty state renders.

One styling fact is pinned, because it is the one thing the migration had to decide: that the rail slot carries `text-[11px]` and that `text-sm` did not survive the merge.

### Ablation — every pin proved able to fail

Each leg mutated the source on disk (verified by grep in both directions — an editor's exit code is not proof), ran, then restored via `git checkout HEAD -- path` with the restore proved by `git hash-object` against the HEAD blob:

```
LEG 1  DatasourcePreview reverted to the hand-rolled span
       -> 2 failed | 4 passed   (RESTORED: blob == HEAD ca8e4ad5)
LEG 2  ValidationPreview reverted to the hand-rolled span
       -> 2 failed | 4 passed   (RESTORED: blob == HEAD 4578f57d)
LEG 3  size override dropped from DatasourcePreview
       -> 1 failed | 6 passed   (RESTORED: blob == HEAD ca8e4ad5)
LEG 4  restored tree -> 6 passed, git diff HEAD empty
```

In every leg the populated lit control stayed green, which is correct: the mutation moves the empty arm only.

## Verification

Run at `b39edae27`, the final commit.

```
vitest  emptyCollection-8570 + emptyCollection-8526   40 passed (2 files)
vitest  packages/app-shell/.../previews/ (whole dir)  623 passed (53 files)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check     exit 0
        (tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json — the new test is covered)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run lint           exit 0, 0 errors
```

Gates, after the closure build (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`):

```
check:control-bytes  check:phantom-deps  check:self-import
check:unreferenced-sources  check:vi-mock-specifiers  check:vi-mock-inherit
check:side-effects-array  check:i18n-keys  changeset:check      all exit 0
check:eager-closure   NOT MEASURED — needs apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json
                      (prerequisite not met locally; declared to CI)
```

Governed-surface guard, with `AGENTS.md` as the lit control:

```
--test <this PR's 3 paths>  exit 0  NOT GOVERNED (3 paths vs 5 governed surfaces)
--test AGENTS.md            exit 3  GOVERNED           <- control is live
```

`Clause-②: no` — the diff is `previews/**` internals plus a changeset; `EmptyDescription` is untouched and gains no key.

## Out of scope, deliberately

The two families the card fences stay untouched: the nine amber warning-toned empties (`JobPreview` / `SkillPreview` / `ValidationPreview` / `BookPreview`) and the five dashed drop-zone placeholders in two dashed conventions. Both wait on a separate decision about whether the shared family grows a tone axis.
